title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the pattern of the data points. Does it resemble any common function shape, such as linear, quadratic, or absolute value?

title: Quadratic Function
text: A quadratic function has the form of a parabola. Check if the data points can be fitted by a parabola, which would suggest a quadratic relationship.

title: Checking for Quadratic Fit
text: Does the scatterplot resemble a parabolic shape, indicating a quadratic relationship?
